text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — pilot readiness discussion. We need to decide final cuts for the pilot that goes to ACME next week.
Alex Chen: I ran the perf tests on the KV cache + batching. If we keep the new cache logic, tail latency drops ~30% at p95.
John Rivera: Can we keep cache and cut multi-region routing? The pilot only needs single region for now.
Liam O'Neill: Agree. Multi-region adds infra + config risk. Cut it for pilot, add to v1.
Sara Gomez: Customers care about cost and latency. If we keep cache, we can defer dedupe-based reranking and dedicated autoscale until v1.
Maya Patel: @Liam @Alex, that tradeoff sounds safe. What about rollout controls / canary? Need minimal rollback.
Alex Chen: Canary requires extra infra, but we can do simple weighted routing at the LB level — very low effort.
John Rivera: So proposed cuts: remove multi-region, defer dedicated autoscale, remove dedupe reranking. Keep KV cache + batching, simple canary.
Maya Patel: That maps to acceptance criteria?
Maya Patel: Pilot acceptance (must-have): p95 latency <= 350ms, error rate < 1%, basic cost estimate within 20% of target, customer sign-off on feature surface.
Sara Gomez: We should add "no data exfil" KMS assurance — quick checklist item for ACME legal.
Liam O'Neill: Timeline: shift v1 GA by 3 weeks to make room for dedicated autoscale + reranking in next sprint. Pilot still on schedule for next Tue.
Maya Patel: Ok — decision: cut multi-region, defer autoscale/rerank to v1, keep cache+batches, add simple canary. v1 timeline +3w. Anyone object?
Alex Chen: :thumbsup: 
John Rivera: :+1: 
Sara Gomez: I'll draft the updated scope doc & send to ACME for sign-off.
Maya Patel: Thanks — I'll update the milestone board and send the note to execs. Looping in @prod-bot to create an action item.
prod-bot: Action created: PROD-412 scope update, assignees: Maya Patel, Sara Gomez, John Rivera.
Maya Patel: Closing — follow ups in the doc thread.
